title: Admin action ledger: RPO-aligned retention automation with tamper-evident export hooks
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: We currently lack an automated, auditable pipeline that enforces admin-action retention (RPO-aligned), ensures append-only storage for custodial evidence, and produces tamper-evident export bundles for legal/regulatory requests. This ticket implements an end-to-end 'admin action ledger' that: 1) records admin actions and config changes into an append-only commit log with per-region residency metadata; 2) automatically applies retention policies (TTL and legal holds) aligned with RPO/RTO tiers; 3) periodically seals export bundles with HSM-backed timestamps and optional blockchain anchor for long-term non-repudiation; 4) exposes operator APIs and Console controls for retention schedules, legal hold, and manual evidence exports; and 5) produces machine-readable evidence packages (signed manifests + proofs) for compliance and downstream escrow workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Admin actions (privileged API, Console change, RBAC updates) are written to append-only ledger with sequence numbers and region tags
Retention engine applies TTL and legal hold rules automatically and respects region/residency constraints
Export bundle generation produces manifest.json, compressed event shards, HSM timestamp sig, and optional anchor proof URL
Evidence bundles can be retrieved via API and Console with access logs and verification steps
End-to-end test that simulates a legal hold + export and validates signature chain and HSM timestamp
Performance: ledger write p50 < 20ms under normal load; export generation for a 24h shard completes within SLA (configurable)
technical_notes: Ledger storage: use existing append-only S3 prefix with object immutability (WORM) + Dynamo sequence index for fast lookups
Anchoring: integrate with HSM stamping service (kms-notary) for signed timestamps; optional anchor to public proof service for long-term verification
Retention engine: extend policy DSL to include RPO tier, region affinity, and legal hold flag; run as a distributed cron with leader election
Export format: tar.gz bundle containing events.ndjson, manifest.json (hash tree roots), signatures.sig, and retention-metadata.json
Access controls: export API requires audit-level role and mfa_recent claim; all export operations emit operator-audit events
Backfill: support a best-effort backfill path to retroactively seal historical shards with HSM timestamps (rate-limited)
